nodes.label: Import order: Directory.Build.props before Directory.Packages.props
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.rationale: A property kept as Version="$(Prop)" in Directory.Packages.props must be defined in a file MSBuild evaluates earlier; Directory.Build.props qualifies because it is imported first.

nodes.label: Inline vs keep version-property decision
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.rationale: Properties used only for versioning may be inlined as literals or kept as references; properties used for other purposes are never removed, their resolved value is used instead.

nodes.label: Obsolete property cleanup with two-check verification
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.norm_label: obsolete property cleanup with two-check verification
nodes.rationale: Remove inlined property definitions only with zero remaining references; verify both $(PropertyName) uses and the <PropertyName> element are gone before final validation.

nodes.label: Out-of-scope property safe options
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.rationale: Stop before editing; expand scope, use resolved literal, or keep the reference only if evaluated earlier. Skipping the central PackageVersion would leave NU1008 or NU1010 after CPM is enabled.

nodes.label: CPM conversion risk levels (Low / Moderate / High)
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.norm_label: cpm conversion risk levels (low / moderate / high)
nodes.rationale: Version-neutral conversion is low risk; minor/patch alignment moderate; major version changes or unexplained differences high.

nodes.label: Only CPM-related errors justify automatic correction
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.norm_label: only cpm-related errors justify automatic correction
nodes.rationale: Environmental blockers (SDK installs, global.json, file locks, package sources) are reported with the failed command rather than fixed; at most one CPM-specific correction then a rerun of the failed batch.

nodes.label: Only the nearest Directory.Packages.props is evaluated
nodes.community_name: Convert To Cpm Validation And Errors
nodes.norm_label: only the nearest directory.packages.props is evaluated
nodes.rationale: MSBuild evaluates only the closest Directory.Packages.props in the project directory or an ancestor; chain multiple files with Import or consolidate.

nodes.label: --watch Background Watcher
nodes.rationale: Code changes rebuild via AST with no LLM; doc changes only set a needs_update flag. Debounce 3s avoids a rebuild per file during agent waves.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs
nodes.rationale: Per-subfolder graphify extract keeps outputs inside each path so the skill's shared graphify-out/ is not clobbered; merged nodes carry a repo attribute.

nodes.label: Interpreter Detection (.graphify_python)
nodes.rationale: Resolves uv tool, pipx shebang or python3; scan root passed via quoted heredoc so a malicious path cannot execute as shell code.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: The query matcher is case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms, so up to 12 tokens are picked only from the graph's own label vocabulary, never invented.

nodes.label: Fast Path: Query Existing Graph
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json exists and the request is a natural-language question, skip Steps 1-5 and run graphify query directly.

nodes.label: When a Graph Is Worth Building
nodes.norm_label: when a graph is worth building
nodes.rationale: Semantic extraction costs minutes and tens of thousands of tokens; a single targeted lookup is cheaper with grep. Build for many questions, large/unfamiliar corpora, doc-to-code links, or structural questions.

nodes.label: Vendored Tool Name Mapping
nodes.rationale: Vendored instructions naming Skill, Task, Read or AskUserQuestion mean the corresponding native Codex capability, not literal tool names; session schemas take precedence.

nodes.rationale: Vendored file is overwritten by the weekly sync, so it must not be edited locally.

nodes.label: Composite Index Column Ordering

nodes.label: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
nodes.rationale: Avoids locking writes in production; two table scans, cannot run in a transaction, leaves INVALID index on failure.

nodes.label: GIN Index
nodes.rationale: Larger and slower to update than B-tree but excels at multi-valued containment (JSONB, arrays, FTS, trigram).

nodes.label: Hash Index
nodes.rationale: Only supports =; rarely better than B-tree.

nodes.label: Index Selection Decision Tree
nodes.rationale: Pick index by operator, selectivity (>10-20% favors seq scan), narrowing, index-only needs, and expressions.

nodes.label: jsonb_path_ops Operator Class
nodes.rationale: 2-3x smaller than jsonb_ops but only supports @> containment.

nodes.label: Partial Index
nodes.rationale: Smaller index means faster lookups and less maintenance; query WHERE must imply the predicate.

nodes.label: Indexes on Partitioned Tables
nodes.rationale: Unique/PK indexes must include all partition key columns; CONCURRENTLY requires ON ONLY parent + per-partition build + ATTACH.

nodes.rationale: Entry card on an 8px notebook grid with ink head and 56px step keys.

nodes.label: Brutal theme
nodes.rationale: Editorial committed theme: raw engineered sheet of 3px rules, boxed cells and solid fills; not a dark hacker page, a decorated zine or a sticker sheet of offset shadows.

nodes.label: Furrow theme
nodes.rationale: Modern-minimal committed theme for farm records: a working records voice drawn on the land; not a pastoral lifestyle page, glossy dashboard or sat-nav.

nodes.label: Luminous air WebGL field
nodes.rationale: One fixed WebGL domain-warped noise field drifting in cream and amber veils behind the page; pointer path parts it; still frame fallback; never a gradient blob.

nodes.label: Acid-yellow fill-only accent
nodes.rationale: The yellow is a fill, never type, rule or ring; always under ink, under 5% of a screen; focus takes deep olive.

nodes.label: Shared-rule boxed cells
nodes.rationale: Neighbouring cells share one 3px rule via negative margins; a doubled 6px seam reads as a mistake.

nodes.label: Generated ASCII field
nodes.rationale: Canvas noise sampled per 8x16 cell into a character ramp tinted in cobalt, shaped by the product's own traffic; never noise for its own sake.

nodes.label: Generated survey map
nodes.rationale: Canvas map generated on load with marching-squares contours, hedges, walls and water, holding edged in tangerine; never a map tile or satellite photograph.

nodes.label: Tangerine signal
nodes.rationale: Tangerine is a fill with ink on it, never type; green marks what is in date.

nodes.label: One spot ink
nodes.rationale: One spot does dots, buttons and fields; a second ink is a different printer; small spot type takes the deep spot.

nodes.label: Colourway dial (graphite / paper / amber-room)
nodes.rationale: Colourway stated in the stamp.

nodes.label: Hairline panels from one surface
nodes.rationale: Panels that sit together are one surface divided by 1px rules; no shadow, glow or bloom.

nodes.label: Measured mono
nodes.rationale: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono only for what an instrument wrote, tabular with slashed zero; never a label, head or control.

nodes.label: Bone wells
nodes.rationale: Light surfaces as bone wells holding one white card.

nodes.label: Hour hero photograph
nodes.rationale: A real landscape at the turn of the light behind the hero with a fog scrim; never a drawn or generated sky. Hour dial: fog / shore / ridge.

nodes.label: Smoked glass surface
nodes.rationale: Product surface in blurred glass with a lit top edge; never glass on glass or glass without its lit edge.

nodes.label: Console theme
nodes.rationale: Modern-minimal restrained dark theme: an instrument kept by careful people; nothing glows; not a neon terminal, glass dashboard or sci-fi control room.

nodes.label: Dusk theme
nodes.rationale: Modern-minimal committed dark theme for finance software: money software at the calm end of the day; expensive and unhurried, never a neon trading screen or dashboard of tiles.

nodes.label: Amber person / cool instrument signals
nodes.rationale: Amber always means a person, cool blue an instrument, in every colourway; swapping them is the theme lying.

nodes.label: Periwinkle / apricot signals
nodes.rationale: Periwinkle is done, matched, on and focused; apricot is open, waiting or owed; neither is a large fill.

nodes.label: Teal means in
nodes.rationale: Teal marks only what is in or open; never a field or running text; out is an outline, never red.

nodes.rationale: App-wide values (theme, auth) are registered via DI instead of a CascadingValue component.

nodes.label: Cascading Context

nodes.label: List-Item Extraction
nodes.rationale: Complex item templates become their own component; @key enables efficient diffing.

nodes.label: Sibling Decomposition
nodes.rationale: Extract independent blocks with no shared state/handlers as sibling components composed by a parent.

nodes.rationale: Read-then-write patterns in READ COMMITTED silently overwrite concurrent updates.

nodes.rationale: Default; fine for simple CRUD with atomic SQL - escalate only for a specific anomaly.

nodes.rationale: Single snapshot; raises serialization errors instead of silently re-evaluating.

nodes.label: SERIALIZABLE (Serializable Snapshot Isolation)
nodes.rationale: Optimistic dependency tracking instead of heavy upfront locks; needs retry logic.

nodes.rationale: Expected behavior, not a bug - applications must catch and retry.

nodes.label: Write Skew Anomaly
nodes.rationale: Not prevented by REPEATABLE READ; requires SERIALIZABLE.

nodes.norm_label: per-task review gate (spec compliance + task quality)

nodes.label: Code organization guidance
nodes.rationale: Agents reason best about code held in context at once; focused files make edits more reliable.

nodes.label: Escalate when in over your head
nodes.norm_label: escalate when in over your head
nodes.rationale: Bad work is worse than no work; escalation via BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT lets the controller add context, upgrade the model, or split the task.

nodes.label: Batching small same-shape work
nodes.rationale: One dispatch per task is reserved for work needing its own judgment, tests, or review surface.

nodes.label: Bounded waiting on dispatched subagents
nodes.rationale: Bounded 5-10 minute stretches keep a long wait's efficiency while ensuring a stuck or lost child is noticed within minutes.

nodes.label: Continuous execution
nodes.rationale: Check-in prompts and progress summaries waste the partner's time; they asked for the plan to be executed.

nodes.label: Four stop conditions
nodes.rationale: Only irreversible/destructive ops, security-sensitive actions, external side effects (merge, push, publish), or a hopelessly broken plan justify stopping.

nodes.label: Fresh subagent per task
nodes.rationale: Isolated, precisely crafted context keeps subagents focused and preserves the controller's context for coordination.

nodes.label: Hand artifacts over as files
nodes.rationale: Everything pasted into a dispatch or printed back stays resident in the controller's context and is re-read every turn.

nodes.label: Do not pre-judge findings for the reviewer
nodes.norm_label: do not pre-judge findings for the reviewer
nodes.rationale: Phrases like 'do not flag' or 'at most Minor' are pre-judging, usually to spare the controller a review loop.

nodes.label: No-subagents contract
nodes.rationale: Every worker-spawned reviewer duplicated the controller's task review, a full extra review seat per task.

nodes.label: Record BASE before dispatch (never HEAD~1)
nodes.rationale: HEAD~1 silently drops all but the last commit of a multi-commit task.

nodes.label: Rulings, not stalls
nodes.rationale: A wrong ruling costs visible, undoable rework; a session parked on a question costs the human partner's whole day.

nodes.label: Spec as binding authority over plan
nodes.norm_label: spec as binding authority over plan
nodes.rationale: The spec is the authority the plan argues from; conflicts inside the plan resolve against it, and rulings without a spec are provisional.

nodes.label: Do not trust the report
nodes.rationale: The implementer's report and design rationales are the implementer grading their own work; a stated rationale never downgrades severity.

nodes.label: Severity calibration (plan-mandated findings are Important)
nodes.rationale: The plan's authorship does not grade its own work; the human decides.
